answer: Problem: Sybil swarms mint fake attestors overnight. Mechanism: each new agent locks a ferrous stake of 0.2 POA for 3 epochs and must finish 2 lotus-scoped sealed grades scoring >=2 before deep attests. Cost: locked capital plus ~15 minutes of grading latency. Verification: peers check escrow height and grade roots on every attest and reject self-clustered panels. Failure-handling: failed grades or a drained escrow freeze the identity for 2 epochs and force a canyon-scoped rebond with a new nonce; dangling atts are dropped.
